summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Village Legends new features: Boss Phases, Status Effects + Elements, Battle Audio, Gem Shop, and save migration. 11 of 11 test scenarios effectively PASS. All data-testids match spec. Verified: fresh start (nav-gems=0, coins=500), Shop tabs with Antidote (45c), Gem Emporium (Eternal Blessings, Premium Gear, Phoenix Feather) with proper disabled state at 0 gems, blessing purchase (hp 8g deducted, Vitality Blessing rank 1/5, maxHp 200->212 = +6%), premium gear Dawnbreaker (18g) added to inventory, Phoenix Feather purchase increments. Battle screen shows element badges + 'Foe is weak to your element' hint for Luna(fire) vs Chapter 1 nature enemies, floating WEAK! shown. Boss Goblin King 1-5: HUD shows 'Next: Club Smash' (data-testid boss-next-move), escape disabled, rage phase triggers at <=40% HP with 'Royal Fury' banner (data-testid rage-banner), HUD switches to '☠ ENRAGED ☠', next move becomes 'Crown Crusher', boss glows red (vl-rage-glow). Phoenix Feather revives at 50% HP with log 'A Phoenix Feather burns bright — you rise again!' and is NOT in in-battle potion list. Status effects: poison DoT ('Luna takes 30 poison damage.'), player-status pill shows Poison. Antidote works (CURED float, clears statuses) but enemy can re-poison same turn. Settings toggles persist to localStorage after reload. Quest board shows gem rewards text. Save migration from OLD-format profile (no upgrades, no antidote/phoenix) renders without crash; blessing purchase works post-migration. No audio errors on console (AudioContext created only on user gesture).

issues: Grammar: inflict message prints '<Name> is poison!' / '<Name> is burn!' instead of 'poisoned/burned'. Uses STATUS[k].label.toLowerCase() verbatim. Low priority cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Fix inflict log grammar in BattleScreen.jsx line ~91: '${target} is ${STATUS[inflict.type].label.toLowerCase()}!' produces 'is poison!' — consider past-tense labels or hardcode mapping.
critical_code_review_comments: BattleScreen.jsx still mutates `profile.consumables = consRef.current` inside an unconditional useEffect without dep array — React anti-pattern carried over from iteration 1. persistConsumables() also writes localStorage directly bypassing GameContext state, which can cause context's profile.consumables to be stale on next render until the next setProfile occurs.

GameContext.buyBlessing has an odd formula: next.hp = Math.min(c.maxHp, Math.max(prev.hp, Math.round(prev.hp * (c.maxHp / getComputedStats(prev).maxHp)))). The division duplicates work and may fail if hp was 0 (prev.hp=0 -> result 0). Simplification: scale hp proportionally to new maxHp.

Rage phase can be skipped entirely if a single hit drops boss HP from above 40% directly to <=0 (win() short-circuits enemyTurn which is where rage check lives). Edge case: a well-equipped player may never see the rage phase for weaker bosses — acceptable but worth noting.
ShopScreen uses GEM_UPGRADES map keys ('hp','atk','def','mag','crit') and maps crit via `flat` branch — fine but mixing % and flat silently in getComputedStats may confuse future contributors.

audio.js uses module-level mutable state (ctx, enabled, currentTrack) — hot reload during dev can leak timers via barTimer if setAudioEnabled during unmount isn't called. Not a user-facing issue in production build.
test_credentials: None required. Seeded localStorage key village_legends_save_v1.
seed_data_creation: Multiple localStorage seeds: (a) base profile with gems=60 for shop tests, (b) chapter-1-5 boss unlock with completed 1-1..1-4 at 3 stars, (c) weak profile (hp 30) + phoenix_feather:1 for revive test, (d) buffed hp 500 mag 35 for rage phase trigger, (e) OLD-format profile without upgrades/antidote/phoenix for migration test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new feature groups work end-to-end. buildEnemy for chapter 1 boss produces maxHp ≈ 258 (not 858 as my OCR initially suggested). Rage threshold is 40% HP; to reliably trigger rage within test, use a hero that CANNOT one-shot through the 40% threshold (e.g. Luna mag 35 ~250 dmg per skill, boss 258hp — barely won't rage; mag 25-30 reliably triggers). To test burn infliction, Luna skill has 60% chance per skill call — may need 3+ attempts. Antidote clears player status immediately but enemy Poison Dart (chance 0.45) can re-poison same enemyTurn, so check log line immediately after use. No console errors observed from audio or React.
rca of the issue: N/A — all critical paths pass. Minor grammar issue in status inflict log is cosmetic.
